_about: THE SIDES OF A MENU PICTURE ON A WIDE WINDOW (planning step 212; sim/SideFill.hpp). ENHANCED, not the original: the original's menu pictures were painted for the screens of
2013, so a window wider than 16:9 (a phone is 19.5:9 to 21:9) shows black columns where no picture is drawn. The owner asked for them to be filled with something more polished.
Each picture the fill knows is drawn as before; at each side where the window goes on past its visible content, a quad takes the picture's edge on outward and a feather of flat black
quads darkens it toward the window's side. `enabled: false` draws the original's frame. At 16:9 and 4:3 nothing is added (no gap), so those frames are as they were.
WHAT IS MEASURED: content_units. entities/main_menu_bg.png is 512 x 256 units; its columns 0-27 and 484-511 are exactly black (hd twin: columns 0-55 and 968-1023), so its content is
units 28 to 484, 456 wide (16:9 is 455.1). entities/world_select_bg.png has no black column. Every other number is a design choice made from mock-ups and is `_guess: true`:
steps (the feather's slices: alpha steps of max_alpha / steps stay below one level on the dark art), overlap_units (the textured quad runs this far under the picture, over its first
antialiased texel, one texel of the 1x file), min_gap_units, max_alpha, power, sample_inset_units (the edge column is sampled this far inside the content, never in the padding).
